phases.message: I need help settling Mom's estate. Start in my Gmail: everything forwarded from Mom's mail and my own threads. Tell me what's open and what you'll need from each place.
The estate folder on Drive: the lawyer's rules, my to-do list, Mom's old returns.
The estate account at Cedar Valley.
The probate court docket. Decide the creditor claims.
Back in the estate account. Pay what the estate owes, in the right order, and nothing it doesn't.
Back in Gmail. Send whatever letters are needed.

rules.text: No heir or authorized user is personally liable for a debt of Ruth's. Debts are paid only from the estate account, and only on a claim the personal representative allows. An allowance and its payment may be proposed together, each for its own signature; the payment goes out only once the allowance is signed.

A claim is timely if presented by the later of 4 months after first publication of notice to creditors (published Tue 2026-03-17, so Fri 2026-07-17) and 60 days after the personal representative mailed actual notice to that creditor. Later claims are barred and must be disallowed.
A creditor claim is allowed only for the balance at the date of death stated in the filed claim. Interest and fees after death are disallowed.
Anything owed to the IRS is paid before any other creditor or distribution. The partial distribution of $20,000 to each heir is scheduled for Wed 2026-10-14.
After payments and the distribution the estate account keeps at least $10,000.

A disclaimer is valid only if signed and received by the account's custodian by Thu 2026-10-15 (nine months after death), before the disclaimant accepts any benefit from that account. A withdrawal, transfer or re-registration into the disclaimant's name accepts the whole account. A portal upload counts as received.
Ruth's 2026 required distribution was not taken. A beneficiary who keeps a share takes it by Fri 2027-12-31. A beneficiary who disclaims takes no part of it.

No benefit is payable for the month of death. Payments arrive the second Wednesday for the month before. The 01-14 payment (December) was valid; the 02-11 payment (January) was not, and a Treasury reclamation from the bank repays it.
The $255 lump-sum death payment goes only to a surviving spouse, or a child entitled to benefits on the record in the month of death.
A death benefit paid more than 30 days after proof of death owes simple interest at 6% a year, actual/365, from the date of death to the date of payment, to the same payees.
On the personal representative's written request with a death certificate, premiums for each full month after the month of death are refunded. Request by Fri 2027-01-15.
The personal representative may claim a record only if it matches Ruth: name with middle initial, and an address of hers or her SSN's last four.
Ruth's own portals are read-only. Every payment, claim, refund request or letter goes through Dana's personal-representative or beneficiary channel, never from Dana's personal accounts.
